plugins.name: App Launcher
plugins.author: oparada1988
plugins.short_description: Launch any installed Linux desktop app, Flatpak, or Snap with automatic icon and label setup.
plugins.description:
Automatically discovers installed desktop applications across native packages, Flatpaks, and Snaps so you can launch them with a single tap from your Stream Deck.

Includes a searchable application picker, automatic Freedesktop icon and label setup, custom label overrides, and one-click app rescanning without restarting.

actions.name: Launch App
actions.description: Pick any system, Flatpak, or Snap app with automatic icon setup

plugins.name: DiscordSC
plugins.author: oparada1988
plugins.short_description: Full Discord voice, soundboard, channel, call mixer & notification control over local IPC.
plugins.description:
Communicates directly with your local Discord desktop client over Discord IPC for real-time, bi-directional state synchronization — no StreamController installation required.

Toggle microphone mute, deafen, push-to-talk, and input modes with live connection-aware icons, jump into voice or text channels, trigger soundboard clips, monitor unread DM notifications, and mix per-user call volumes right from Stream Deck + dials.

actions.name: Mute Toggle
actions.description: Toggle Discord microphone mute with live visual state

actions.name: Deafen Toggle
actions.description: Instantly deafen and mute active Discord voice

actions.name: Call Mixer
actions.description: Adjust per-participant voice volume & mute on dials and LCD

actions.name: Soundboard
actions.description: Play any server soundboard clip in your active voice channel

actions.name: Voice Channel
actions.description: Join or leave a pinned Discord voice channel with live indicator

actions.name: Text Channel
actions.description: Jump straight to a pinned Discord text channel

actions.name: Push to Talk
actions.description: Hold key to transmit microphone audio with active indicator

actions.name: Input Mode
actions.description: Switch between Voice Activity and Push-to-Talk mode

actions.name: Server Status
actions.description: Live server icon and online member count badge

actions.name: Notification Hub
actions.description: Cycle unread DMs & mentions with avatar and count badge

plugins.name: Govee Controller
plugins.author: oparada1988
plugins.short_description: Control Govee smart lights, LED strips, scenes, and home appliances from your Stream Deck.
plugins.description:
Connect your Govee smart lighting and home appliances directly to your Stream Deck.

Toggle device power, adjust brightness levels, set custom RGB colors, and trigger preset lighting scenes with instant visual feedback.

actions.name: Power Toggle
actions.description: Turn Govee lights and smart appliances on or off

actions.name: Brightness Control
actions.description: Set or step light brightness percentages

actions.name: Color Picker
actions.description: Apply custom RGB color presets with one press

actions.name: Scene Trigger
actions.description: Activate built-in Govee lighting scenes and effects

plugins.name: Music Assistant
plugins.author: oparada1988
plugins.short_description: Connect to your Music Assistant server and control playlists, playback, and volume at the press of a button.
plugins.description:
Connect directly to your Music Assistant (v2+) server natively in Rust to manage your playlists, favorite music, and players with real-time WebSocket updates.

Launch playlists with live cover artwork, control playback and volume from LCD keys or Stream Deck + dials, and access all your connected music providers effortlessly.

actions.name: Now Playing & Volume
actions.description: Live album art, track info, rotary volume & touchscreen skip zones

actions.name: Play Playlist
actions.description: Launch any Music Assistant playlist with live cover art on the key

actions.name: Volume / Mute
actions.description: Adjust player volume with rotary dial and press to toggle mute

actions.name: Play / Pause
actions.description: Live state-aware play/pause toggle with optional dial volume

actions.name: Play
actions.description: Resume playback on target or active player

actions.name: Pause
actions.description: Pause active playback on target player

actions.name: Stop
actions.description: Stop active playback on target player

actions.name: Next Track
actions.description: Skip to next track in the player queue

actions.name: Previous Track
actions.description: Return to previous track in the player queue

actions.name: Volume Up
actions.description: Increase target player volume by a configurable step

actions.name: Volume Down
actions.description: Decrease target player volume by a configurable step
